regions.today: Dry and bright this evening with light northwesterly or variable breezes.
regions.tonight: Tonight will remain dry with plenty of clear spells at first. It will turn cloudier towards morning. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 11 degrees in a light southerly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be dry for some with a mixture of cloud and hazy sunny spells at first. There may be the odd patch of light rain or drizzle, mainly in western parts. Feeling milder as cloud builds throughout the day. Further patches of light rain and drizzle will develop in western parts towards days end. Highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees in moderate southerly winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate on Wednesday and low to moderate on Thursday.
